Professional Summary
QA Automation Engineer with strong hands-on experience in building and executing automated test suites for web applications. Skilled in designing reliable, maintainable automation frameworks, integrating tests into CI pipelines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Automation Testing, TestNG, Postman, Cypress, Git, Linux, Agile

Work Experience
QA Automation Engineer, Bluefin Logistics (Nov 2025 - Present)
- Implemented end-to-end automated test suites for the company’s shipment tracking web portal using TestNG and Selenium, increasing automated coverage of critical user flows by automating regression scenarios.
- Developed fast, stable front-end integration tests with Cypress to validate real-time tracking UI components and map rendering, reducing manual UI verification time before releases.
- Integrated test execution into CI pipelines using Git hooks on Linux runners and automated nightly Postman collections for API smoke tests, improving early defect detection.
- Collaborated with product and development teams in Agile sprints to create test strategies, triage issues, and maintain test artifacts, resulting in quicker sprint acceptance and fewer production hotfixes.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
